title: Reply coding codebook (v1)
instructions: Code EACH reply independently from its text only. When unsure, choose the more conservative (lower-severity) code and note it.

contexts.parent: Replies to @AutisticClip, who posted a clip: "Asmongold and Adin Ross offer QTCinderella $200,000 for charity to prove the Streamer Awards aren't rigged."
contexts.child: Replies to @DirtbagLeft1234, who quote-tweeted that clip: "Then why not just give $200,000 to charity without making it a weird stunt about your friend's award show?" The handle signals a left-wing identity.

fields.name: stance
fields.definition: Stance toward the Asmongold/Adin $200k offer. pro_stunt: defends Asmongold/Adin or the offer, or attacks its critics. anti_stunt: criticises the offer/Asmongold/Adin, or agrees with the child OP. neutral: on topic, no side. off_topic. unclear.

fields.name: incivility
fields.definition: Insults, name-calling, profanity aimed at a person or group, contemptuous mockery. Plain disagreement or sarcasm without insult = 0.

fields.name: attacks_op
fields.definition: Personal attack on the author being replied to (child: DirtbagLeft1234; parent: AutisticClip or QTCinderella counts as 0 here, code target separately).

fields.name: target
fields.definition: Who the hostility (if any) is aimed at.

fields.name: slur
fields.definition: Uses a slur (racial, ethnic, religious, homophobic, transphobic, misogynist, or ableist such as "retard/retarded"), whether or not aimed at a protected group.

fields.name: hate_speech
fields.definition: STRICT definition: attacks, dehumanises, or calls for harm against people BECAUSE OF a protected characteristic (race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, caste, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, serious disease, age). Using "retarded" as a generic insult at someone who is not disabled: slur=1 and hate_speech=0 unless it demeans disabled people as a group. Misogynist attacks on QTCinderella because she is a woman (e.g. gendered slurs, "women can't...") = 1.

fields.name: political_identity_attack
fields.definition: Attacks someone for political identity (commie, leftist, libtard, socialist, MAGA, fascist, etc.). Not a protected class; recorded separately.

fields.name: threat
fields.definition: Threat of violence or wish of harm/death, including "kys".

fields.name: note
fields.definition: At most 15 words, only if useful (for example, ambiguity).
